newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs overbought,support at 132.75 beckons.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs overbought,support at 132.75 beckons.

text.p: September BTPs may manage to reach 134.00 resistance on Monday, but with the market so overbought, profit takers will soon step in and drive the contract to support at 132.75, technical analysts said.
Carol Harmer, a trader and analyst at Kempton's Technical Analysis in London, said BTPs needed to break and hold over 133.46/50 to keep the immediate pressure to the topside.
"Faliure to do so will result in the market trading lower with 133.11 the immediate attraction," she said.
By 0729 GMT, September BTPs were up five basis points at 133.36.
"Be ready to re-introduce shorts on a break below 132.95," said Harmer. "This would keep the pressure to the downside and leave 132.55/49 targeted."
Marc Ostwald, technical analyst at London Bond Broking, said BTPs may trade up initially, but added profit takers would soon step in.
"I think it's fabulously overbought, the degree of optimism is quite unbelievable," he said.
Ostwald put resistance at 133.70, the contract high reached on June 19, then at 134.00, a psychological level and the first resistance on weekly charts.
"We might well trade that up initially, especially if there is a better tone elsewhere," he said.
"But when the real profit taking comes in, it will be quite dramatic."
Ostwald noted there was not much support below the June 18 high at 133.39. "The next support is at 132.75, the low on Friday, then 132.67, the high on June 17."
Below there, the June 17 low of 132.14, then the June 12 high of 131.77 would kick in, Ostwald said.
By 0748 GMT, September Eurolira was up three basis points at 93.53.
